The change in AAPL's research and development expense from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2024 is an increase of 4.86%.

- Fiscal 2023 R&D expense: $29,915 million [AAPL 10-K 2024, Item 8, chunk AAPL_10K_2024-09-28#0146]
- Fiscal 2024 R&D expense: $31,370 million [AAPL 10-K 2024, Item 7, chunk AAPL_10K_2024-09-28#0078]

Arithmetic:  
Change = $31,370 - $29,915 = $1,455 million  
Percentage change = ($1,455 / $29,915) × 100 = 4.86% (rounded to two decimal places).

**8.02%** of AAPL's total revenue in fiscal 2024 was spent on research and development expense.

Calculation: ($31,370 million R&D expense [AAPL 10-K 2024, Item 8, chunk AAPL_10K_2024-09-28#0146] ÷ $391,035 million total revenue [AAPL 10-K 2024, Item 8, chunk AAPL_10K_2024-09-28#0101]) × 100 = 8.02%.

- AAPL R&D share = $31,370 / $391,035 ≈ 8.02%  

- MSFT R&D expense: $29,510 million [MSFT 10-K 2024, Item 7, chunk MSFT_10K_2024-06-30#0142]

- MSFT R&D share = $29,510 / $245,122 ≈ 12.04%  

MSFT’s R&D share (12.04%) is larger than AAPL’s (8.02%).
